source.title: Ka0s Loot History 1.5.0 source audit: CSV columns, DECONSTRUCT ledger and attribution
source.author: tusharsaxena / aDd1kTeD2Ka0s

notes: NEW source-code-verified potential first-person yield-ledger acquisition route, NOT a player sample or gameplay cast. Ka0s Loot History 1.5.0 (release Oct 9 2026; author targets Retail 12.1.0) labels completed-player-spell source as DISENCHANT/MILLING/PROSPECTING, collects item gain CHAT_MSG_LOOT rows with exact itemID, output quantity and timestamp, and also derives item-loss ledger rows with reason DECONSTRUCT via bag/holdings reconciliation. History CSV header explicitly provides ts/date/time/char/itemID/itemName/qualityRaw/itemLevel/quantity/source/wowheadLink/dir/kind/holder (among other fields), and wowheadLink reconstructs item bonus IDs from a stored itemLink. Limitations critical: CSV excludes raw itemLink, sourceDetail, confidence and event/cast GUID; input DECONSTRUCT losses are derived from inventory snapshot (linkFor looks for surviving same-ID link or falls back to item:<id> after loss), so 272246 actual disenchant-at-ilvl305 cannot be proved from loss row alone. The ledger merges same holder/item/direction/reason rows within 60 seconds, which destroys a 0/1/2 per-cast histogram if repeated rapidly; matching same-second input/output rows is not a verified unique-cast pair, and missing output rows are not proof of zero outcome. NO player CSV or permissioned original observed event file is linked in publisher source; 0 measured casts/0 material hits/0 observed zeros advanced. Controlled single homogeneous recipe/gear plus contemporaneous itemLink screenshot, confirmed cast counter, isolated acquisition, >=60s gaps for same key, refund and rank checks COULD make this an acquisition route, subject to Retail 12.1.5 client verification and source capture; do not infer casts by lost ore/5 if Resourcefulness can refund. Source code: Attribution.lua DeconstructSource/OnSpellSucceeded and loot-window stamping; Collector.lua BuildRecord/OnChatMsgLoot; Reconciler.lua MakeRow/Write 60s coalescing; Export.lua CSV fields and wowheadLink; core/Ledger.lua source reason.
lookingFor: Permissioned original current-patch input-item-linked per-completed-cast material/zero histories for gear Disenchant 272246 ilvl305; Umbral Tin Ore 237362; Refulgent Copper 237359; Brilliant Silver 237365; Tranquility Bloom 236761 milling (ten-herb batches); exact output ranks 242606/242607/242610/242611/242608/242786/242788 and 243599/243600/243602/243603/243605/243606.
